story:
Bobby the Bear Who Was Too Shy

In a peaceful forest full of tall trees, lived a gentle bear named Bobby.

Bobby loved music.

He sang softly when no one was around.

But there was one problem…

Bobby was too shy to sing in front of others.

One day, the animals planned a music show.

“Come sing with us!” said Lila the Lark.

Bobby shook his head.

“No… I can’t,” he said.

“What if I make a mistake?”

Bobby stayed behind a tree.

He watched others sing.

They clapped, smiled, and cheered.

“I wish I could do that,” Bobby whispered.

Lila flew over.

“You sing beautifully,” she said.

Bobby looked surprised.

“Really?” he asked.

“Yes,” said Lila. “Just try.”

Bobby took a deep breath.

He stepped forward.

His voice trembled at first.

“La… la…”

But he kept going.

Soon, Bobby’s voice grew strong.

The animals listened quietly.

Then—

Clap! Clap! Clap!

“That was wonderful!” they said.

Bobby smiled.

“I wasn’t so scared after all,” he said.

From that day on, Bobby sang with joy.

Don’t let fear stop you.

Trying can help you shine.

The End
